fusions.name: Puffball Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Rotted Through
fusions.desc: A heavy kick that uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 18 damage, 60% more for each one consumed, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sown Underfoot
fusions.desc: Treads a spore pod into the ground that lasts 12 seconds. The first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles set it off, and it deals 18 damage in a burst around it.

fusions.name: Thrush
fusions.desc: Each hit you land builds a stack on the target, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once in a blow against that enemy. Unfed, the stacks fade.
